provenance.mascot: The site red-panda cyclist from its approved generated source (sha256 14a201c57d9ca2a95416fd12e7beb17ad248ed187d24636a6e8a98d70d23e46d; assets/branding/provenance.json). A code rig redraws the legs, cranks, pedals and spokes in the artwork's own colours, restores the frame tubes the legs covered, sways the tail and bobs the body slightly; the head, helmet, face, jersey, arms, hands, handlebar, frame and wheel rings keep the original artwork. Each pose is drawn at source resolution and Lanczos-downscaled.

text.typeface: Apple system font (SF), rasterised; no font file is distributed
